subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should OpenClaw accept a custom yielding extra-bootstrap glob walker and bootstrap-only hook scheduling as the bounded fix for the linked event-loop stall?
rationale: The implementation is targeted and has real-loader proof, but bootstrap file selection and hook timing feed prompt/session behavior where a runtime owner must accept the upgrade contract rather than automation deciding it.

options.title: Land after exact-head verification
options.body: Accept the bounded compatibility tradeoff, require the remaining exact-head checks to complete successfully, and merge this focused mitigation.

options.title: Request a connected runtime proof
options.body: Keep the current patch shape but request a redacted latest-head embedded-run or channel-latency trace showing channel work proceeds during the slow bootstrap path.

options.title: Pause for a different architecture
